## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Running the command on an existing setting now prints its adoption message twice, so the CLI filter needs fixing before the new `adopt` entries ship.

## Changes
`plan` now adds an `adopt` entry for each setting that already exists and adds a trailing `audit` entry with the incoming count. Two tests cover the audit entry through `run`, and the PR adds `app/review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop `run` re-emitting adopt entries already reported — If you call `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)`, it emits "Adopted theme" twice. `plan` sends it as progress at line 8, and `app/cli.py:7` skips only `audit`, so it emits the new `adopt` entry's message again. No test calls `run` with an existing setting. — Every adopted setting appears twice in the command's output, which goes against the PR body's statement that the command renders actionable changes. — Fix: Skip `adopt` along with `audit` in `app/cli.py:7`, and add a `run` case with an existing key next to `test_adoption_progress`.
